evidence.title: blobatar components — avatar UI for shadcn

name: blobatar components
summary: Five shadcn registry components built on blobatar: presence avatar, agent list, user table, password field, group chat.
description: Five pieces of interface built on the blobatar avatar generator, each one a shadcn registry item: a presence avatar with unread and thinking states, an agent list for agent runners, a user table with a face per row, a password field and a group chat. The generator stays in the package, so what you copy is the composition.
contains: 5 components: presence avatar, agent list, user table, password field, group chat
each one installable as a shadcn registry item with the shadcn CLI
presence avatar has unread and thinking states with blink/breathing animation
